releases.notes:
One of the major changes is that, starting with this version, the mod no longer depends on FrozenLib and now requires only Fabric API.

- Mosaic versions of poplar wood blocks have been added.
- There are no particles left from the copper camfire now.

If you encounter any bugs with the mod, please report them [here](https://github.com/SergoFoox/VerseCraft/issues).
